portraits.name: 綠眼蝙怪
portraits.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square collectible fantasy creature portrait for this game. Input 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its polished sculpted stylized 3D fantasy illustration, tactile soft surfaces, expressive glossy eyes, cinematic natural lighting and rich atmospheric forest depth. Input 2 is the CHARACTER IDENTITY reference: reproduce that character, not the deer. Full immersive environment, one centered readable creature. No lettering, no frame, no logo, no watermark, no model-sheet panels, no studio backdrop. Character: a round spherical green cyclops bat monster with lime/olive spots, a single large emerald eye FLUSH on its face, separate open U mouth with two small ivory fangs, two large upper bat membrane wings and two smaller lower wings, little curved leaf-tail. Playful but powerful expression. Hovering over a mossy forest ruin at dusk, green hypnotic rings and subtle violet electric poison sparks encircle an orb beneath it. Keep all four wings visible and clear.
